result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, with consistent card spacing, clear section headers, and a tidy bottom navigation bar. The main visual problems are content-level: a meaningless '−0%' discount badge on the pizza card and a redundant '€0 delivery' message on the ramen card. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off pizza card were excluded as intentional scroll behavior.

issues.description: The pizza card in 'Popular right now' shows a '−0%' discount badge. A zero percent discount is meaningless and looks like a rendering or data error.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount is 0%, or show a real offer when one exists.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows '€0 delivery' twice: once as a badge on the image and again in the meta line below the title.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery information in only one place, such as the image badge or the meta line, to reduce clutter.
